summary: A first-year reader: Brandon, almost nine, badly wants a dog, but his mother hesitates because a dog is a big responsibility; he will do almost anything to get one, including keeping a dog secret. Built on only 104 unique words with heavy repetition, cognates and illustrations, 69 pages, with past- and present-tense versions.
